title: Mesenchymal Stromal Cell Culture and Delivery in Autologous Conditions: A Smart Approach for Orthopedic Applications
protocol: Collect bone marrow from the femoral medullary canal after a total hip replacement surgery.
Use heparinized syringes for bone marrow recovery to prevent clot formation.
Prepare autologous plasma for the clot preparation from autologous peripheral blood.
Collect 20 mL of peripheral blood in vacuum blood collection tubes containing K3 EDTA.
Centrifuge at 2,400 × g for 15 min.
Aspirate the plasma component and transfer into a 15 mL tube.
Freeze the plasma at -20 °C until usage.
Transfer the unit of plasma into a transfer bag using a spike.
Disconnect the filled bag by welding and weigh to calculate the volume of plasma.
Coagulate the autologous plasma by injecting calcium gluconate 100 mg/mL through the port connector.
Place the bag at 4 °C O/N without shaking to facilitate clot formation.
Centrifuge the bag at 4,900 × g for 15 min at RT.
Remove the bag carefully after centrifugation.
Isolate the clot just above the clamp to facilitate filtration.
Connect the filtration kit to the transfer bag using a spike placed into the outlet port of the filtration kit.
Hang the bag and open the blue clamp to let the serum flow by gravity.
Seal the tubing and remove the bag after filtration.
Transfer serum into 50 mL tubes under a laminar flow bench.
Take a sample with a syringe to test the absence of fibrinogen.
Perform a sterility test for aerobic and anaerobic bacterial cultures.
Label the tubes appropriately.
Freeze the labeled tubes at -20°C until usage.
Prepare 500 mL of complete proliferation medium.
Add 10% autologous serum to Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium - Low Glucose (DMEM-LG).
Add 2 mM glutamine to the mixture.
Add 1% antibiotic solution to the mixture.
Add 1% antimycotic solution to the mixture.
Sterile-filter the complete proliferation medium.
Transfer the bone marrow sample from the syringe into a 50 mL conical tube.
Dilute the bone marrow sample with sterile saline at a ratio of 1:4.
Vortex the 50 mL tube for 30 seconds.
Warm the density gradient to room temperature before usage.
Layer the diluted bone marrow gently onto the density gradient.
Centrifuge at 400 × g without brake at 25°C for 30 minutes.
Collect the mononuclear fraction at the liquid-liquid interface using a sterile 5 mL pipette.
Transfer the collected mononuclear fraction to a new 50 mL tube.
Wash the collected mononuclear fraction twice with complete proliferation medium.
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 × g for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Discard the supernatant and gently resuspend each cell pellet in 5 mL of complete proliferation medium.
Dilute cells at a 1:100 ratio for cell counting.
Count cells using a hemocytometer after a 1:1 dilution with Trypan Blue staining to evaluate viability.
Fill two or more 75 cm² tissue culture flasks with 15 mL of fresh complete proliferation medium and transfer to an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO₂ until usage.
Seed 0.3 - 0.5 x 10⁶ cells/cm² (37.5 x 10⁶ cells/15 mL) in flasks and incubate at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 48 h.
Seed 1 x 10⁶ cells in a 25 cm² TC flask with 5 mL of fresh complete proliferation medium for the CFU-F assay.
Culture for 2 weeks (to be continued).
Discard the medium and gently wash flasks from step 6.2 with complete proliferation medium to remove nonadherent cells and debris.
Add fresh medium to the flasks and replace half of it twice a week until 70 - 80% confluency is reached.
Recover cells by using a specific recombinant animal-free protease as recommended by the manufacturer (3 mL per flask).
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 10 min.
Add 6 mL of complete proliferation medium per flask and collect in one 50 mL tube.
Dilute ascorbic acid solution 1:10 with DMEM-LG to obtain a 20 mg/mL working solution.
Stock aliquots of diluted ascorbic acid solution at -20°C until usage.
Resuspend 1 g hydrocortisone in 10 mL of sterile water to make a 100 mg/mL stock solution.
Dilute the hydrocortisone stock solution at 1:1,000 with DMEM-LG to obtain a working solution of 100 μg/mL.
Stock aliquots of diluted hydrocortisone solution at -20°C until usage.
Prepare fresh osteogenic medium by adding DMEM-LG with 10% autologous serum, 50 µg/mL ascorbic acid and 0.4 µg/mL hydrocortisone.
Sterile-filter the prepared osteogenic medium before use.
Completely remove the proliferation medium and add osteogenic medium 96 h before cell harvesting.
Provide an additional osteogenic medium change 24 h before cell harvesting.
Detach the cells as described in step 6.5 and gently resuspend the pellet adding 2 mL of complete proliferation medium in a 50 mL tube.
Wash the cells with complete proliferation medium after counting.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min to prepare the washed cells.
Resuspend the pellet gently at 1 - 2 x 10^6 viable cells/2 mL of autologous plasma per 50 mL tube.
Add 150 µl of calcium gluconate at 100 mg/mL to each 50 mL tube obtained from step 8.3.
Resuspend the cells under gentle shaking after adding calcium gluconate.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 15 - 30 min to obtain hMSC/fibrin clot constructs.
Prepare a fibrin clot construct without cells as a control.
Remove the liquid from the 50 mL tubes for cell viability assay.
Add 1 mL of complete proliferation medium containing 10% v/v cell viability reagent (AB) according to the manufacturer's guidelines.
Incubate the tubes at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 3 h.
Measure the absorbance at 570 nm with a reference wavelength of 600 nm.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 2 mL of fresh complete proliferation medium.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 overnight.
Repeat steps 10.1 to 10.3 the next day.
Fix the hMSC/fibrin clot constructs in 4% w/v neutral buffered formalin O/N at 4 °C.
Wash 4 times in D-PBS for 15 min each.
Store in 70% ethanol.
Dehydrate samples in a series of graded ethanol: once with 80% for 30 min, twice with 95% for 45 min each, three times with 100% for 1 h each.
Clarify samples twice in xylene for 45 min at 40 °C.
Rinse the samples in liquid paraffin at 60 °C for 2 h and embed them.
Cut the paraffin block with a microtome and mount sections (5 µm) on glass slides.
Stain deparaffinized sections using standard Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) method.
Treat the sections with 1% silver nitrate for 15 min, then with 0.5% Pyrogallol for 2 min, followed by 5% sodium thiosulfate for 2 min.
Counterstain the sections with 0.1% nuclear fast red diluted in a solution containing 5 g aluminum sulphate for 5 min and rinse them in tap water for 5 min.
Mount the sections with a mounting agent.
Evaluate mineral deposition as black granules under light microscope at 400X magnification.
Wash the 25 cm² flask with D-PBS.
Stain using the standard May-Grunwald/Giemsa method.
Visually quantify hMSC number by scoring individual colonies under a light microscope.
